Q: Thanks for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement is about the rear-end collision you
were involved in in Sugar Land. Do you understand that this call is being recorded?
A: Yes, I understand.
Q: Please tell me in your own words what happened.
A: I was stopped at a red light on a busy road in Sugar Land, behind a silver sedan. I was waiting for the light to
change when I felt a hard jolt from behind. The other vehicle hit my rear bumper.
Q: Had you been stopped for long before the impact?
A: Only a few seconds. The light had just turned red, and I had come to a complete stop.
Q: Did you notice the other driver's speed before the collision?
A: Not really. I was looking forward at the light. I only heard tires and then the impact.
Q: After the collision, what did you do?
A: I stayed in my seat for a minute. My right knee had struck the lower part of the dashboard, and it was throbbing. I
got out, checked my car, and exchanged information with the other driver.
Q: Where are you feeling pain now?
A: My right knee is swollen and sore, especially when I bend it or put weight on it. I also have some stiffness in my
lower back.
Q: Have you sought medical care since the accident?
A: Yes, I went to an urgent care clinic the same day and was advised to follow up with an orthopedic provider.
Q: Is tehre anything else you would like to add?
A: No, I think that covers it. I am willing to provide any records you need.
Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
A: Thank you.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page

- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

- "reason": one short sentence.
